title: Taxonomies: Term Pages That List Their Content | Orchard Core
description:
A taxonomy sorts content into terms, but visitors also need a way to browse your site by term, such as all the posts of one category or one tag.

A term page gives each term an address of its own and lists the content items that have the term selected in a taxonomy field. Terms get their pages when the taxonomy routes them, and the Page size of the site decides how many items a page holds.

In this video:
• What a term page is, and how its address is built
• Browsing from a post to the page of its category and its tag
• Routing the terms from the taxonomy, with Route contained items and the Permalink of a term
• Controlling how many items a term page holds with the Page size
• The four things a term page needs
